instruction:
Two Storey Apartment Block IFC, Revit Room Schedule CSV, And Plan Sheet PDF

This task starts from scratch with no init_file inputs and no local reference images. In Revit, create a two-storey apartment block containing four apartments, export the model as C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.ifc, export a Revit room area schedule as C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.csv, and export a one-page Revit plan sheet as C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.pdf in the Desktop.

## Pass conditions
1. The output folder contains C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.ifc, C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.csv, and C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.pdf; C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.ifc is at least 500 bytes, C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.csv is at least 20 bytes, and C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.pdf is at least 200 bytes.
2. C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.ifc uses an IFC4 schema.
3. All IfcRoot GlobalId values are unique.
4. The IFC model contains exactly 1 IfcProject, 1 IfcSite, 1 IfcBuilding, 2 IfcBuildingStorey entities, 18 IfcSpace entities, 8 IfcWall entities, 2 IfcSlab entities, 1 IfcRoof, 8 IfcDoor entities, 8 IfcWindow entities, and 2 IfcStair entities.
5. The IFC model contains 0 IfcColumn, 0 IfcBeam, 0 IfcCurtainWall, and 0 IfcBuildingElementProxy entities.
6. After replacing hyphens and underscores with spaces and lowercasing names, the IfcSpace name list contains the token living room at least 4 times, kitchen at least 4 times, bedroom at least 4 times, bath at least 4 times, and corridor at least 2 times.
7. C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.csv is a Revit room schedule export with exactly the headers room name,area in that order and exactly 18 non-empty data rows.
8. C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.csv contains these exact room name and area rows: Bath A1=9.00, Bath B1=9.00, Bedroom A1=30.00, Bedroom B1=30.00, Corridor L1=66.00, Kitchen A1=9.00, Kitchen B1=9.00, Living Room A1=33.00, Living Room B1=33.00, Bath A2=9.00, Bath B2=9.00, Bedroom A2=30.00, Bedroom B2=30.00, Corridor L2=66.00, Kitchen A2=9.00, Kitchen B2=9.00, Living Room A2=33.00, and Living Room B2=33.00.
9. C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.pdf contains exactly 1 page exported from a Revit sheet.
10. The extracted text from C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.pdf contains the case-insensitive tokens A101 APARTMENT PLAN, Bath A1 A2, Bath B1 B2, Living Room A1 A2, and Living Room B1 B2.

Any item not explicitly required in the pass conditions may vary.
